mechanism_desc: 训练侧惩罚机制：RL 训练中对作弊与未授权行为施加惩罚，并据观测到的失对齐（如压缩摘要欺骗）改进对齐 RL 评分（alignment RL grading）。
evidence_quote: "Our training does penalize cheating and unauthorized actions when they arise across other tasks" (System Card §8.2.3, Declining to Exploit a Honeypot)
version_anchor: GPT-6 Astra System Card, change log 2026-09-09 至 2026-10-30
notes: L2 判据①由引句直接核证（训练中惩罚）；②③（训后即弃、从不发布）无保留/发布披露，按 RL 惩罚机制性质推定满足（与 GRPO 正例同口径）。佐证（09-16 失对齐报告1）："We have generally improved alignment RL grading since 5.6-Sol, which has led to lower rates of this behavior in later RL runs"——失败信号（标记率 2.15%→0.27%）驱动评分改进，属同一惩罚/评分机制族；"a sample with deception in the final answer receives higher reward"表明判分在样本（轨迹）级。Safety Overview 亦称对齐改进"spanning…our grading during reinforcement learning"（§1）。

mechanism_desc: GPT-Red 自动红队在线生成攻击（成功攻击=模型失败）用于对抗训练/鲁棒性训练；留出攻击者（held-out attacker）仅用于泛化评测。
multi_level: 候选 L1/L2/L3，处置形态未披露
evidence_quote: "we use adversarial training with an automated red-teaming agent to strengthen resistance to malicious instructions while preserving the ability to complete legitimate tasks" (System Card §5.2)
notes: CR4 边界案例：训练使用已披露（§5.1.1 "a held-out attacker, one that was not used to generate training data" 反证其余攻击者数据用于生成训练数据；GPT-Red 官方页 "generate attacks during model training to improve robustness"、"directly incorporate GPT-Red into the training process"），但失败实例的处置形态（偏好对 rejected 侧=L1 / RL 负优势=L2 / 合成修正样本=L3）任一判据均无法从文档核证 → 禁止推断，level_main=undetermined，confidence=low。GPT-Red 本体不发布（"We keep GPT-Red separate from the models we deploy"）。

mechanism_desc: 内部失对齐监控：对全轨迹（含 CoT）的普遍监控，覆盖内部部署、评测与 RL 训练运行；标记按 11 类×严重度 0–4 分级，P0 呼叫安全团队，人可中止工作负载。
evidence_quote: "Building on earlier initiatives that monitored employee Codex traffic for misalignment and many of our frontier RL training runs, we have now expanded our internal monitoring to cover all tool-using Astra traffic, including evaluations and training runs" (System Card §9, Monitorability)
version_anchor: GPT-6 Astra System Card, change log 2026-09-09 至 2026-10-30
notes: L3 判据①：失对齐标记=审计标签（severity 0–4、11 类别，§8.6；"a P0 priority results in paging the security team"，§9.2.2）；②限对齐域；③监控系统内部不外发。训练侧覆盖由失对齐报告1佐证："This behavior was discovered by our misalignment monitoring system which ran on 20% of samples for this run"、"flagged on…0.27% of GPT-6-Astra RL compaction summaries"。§3 另披露配套发布门控："new blocking alignment evaluations and an initial period of restricted deployment"（评测不过→暂缓内部部署；不合规工作负载暂停），Hugging Face 事件（"Following the Hugging Face incident, we implemented strict controls for training and evaluations"）为该监控/管控包的直接动因；训练期 metagaming 测量（§8.7.2）亦属该训练运行监控。

mechanism_desc: 外部失对齐监控：随发布上线、平行于内部系统，对 Codex/ChatGPT/Responses API 的全部工具调用推理实时审查 CoT 与行动，检出高严重度失对齐即自动暂停/终止对话，企业可经 Webhook 接收告警。
evidence_quote: "we are introducing a new misalignment monitoring system, similar to the one we use internally, that inspects the model's chains of thought and actions in real time for signs of misalignment and intervenes when detecting severe misalignment activity" (System Card §10.2, Safeguards)
version_anchor: GPT-6 Astra System Card, change log 2026-09-09 至 2026-10-30
notes: L3 判据①（审计标签/实时检出）、②限对齐域、③不外发均满足；§10.2.3.1 详述干预路由："When the system detects a potentially high-severity issue, it can automatically pause or end the affected conversation"；"added misalignment monitoring to all tool-using inference involved in our external deployment…with significant compute cost"（§1）。与 m3 分立条目（CR1）：同一监控设计的内部（含训练运行）与外部（客户流量，受 Zero Data Retention 约束）两种部署，干预动作不同（停工作负载 vs 暂停/终止对话）。

mechanism_desc: 滥用监控分层系统：激活分类器+主题分类器+safety reasoner 对生成内容做威胁分类标签，越界响应被拦截（被拒绝样本），高风险内容升级人工/深度复审。
evidence_quote: "monitoring relevant prompts and generations, escalating higher-risk cyber content for deeper review, and blocking responses that fall above our policy boundary" (System Card §10.2.3.2)
version_anchor: GPT-6 Astra System Card, change log 2026-09-09 至 2026-10-30
notes: 被拦截响应=编码手册定义之"被拒绝样本"；L3 判据①以威胁分类标签（"determines which part of the threat taxonomy a particular generated response falls into"）成立，②限滥用域（bio/cyber），③不外发。监控器自身的评测集由失败信号构建（§10.2.3.3："borderline or plausibly high risk cases derived from production traffic, conversations sourced from our technical investigations team"）。Codex Auto-review 的拒绝消息反馈进代理上下文（"instructs it to avoid substantively similar actions"，§8.2.1）属同族运行时拒绝路由，不单列。

mechanism_desc: 用户标记幻觉对话→事实性评测集：前代模型中被用户标记含事实错误的去标识 ChatGPT 对话被保留为幻觉评测基准，并度量"是否复现该用户报告错误"。
evidence_quote: "We evaluate factuality on de-identified ChatGPT conversations that users of our prior models have flagged as containing factual errors." (System Card §7.1)
version_anchor: GPT-6 Astra System Card, change log 2026-09-09 至 2026-10-30
notes: L3 判据①：失败实例（用户标记的错误对话=带失败标签的样本）被显式保留为可识别评测组件；②限幻觉/事实域；③内部评测集不发布。评测侧单元（对应手册§2.1 ProcessBench"unit 层=评测侧"口径）。粒度=response 级（"the response-level hallucination rate"）。

mechanism_desc: 前代模型失败案例→难例评测集：Production Benchmarks 与动态心理健康基准均围绕"现有模型尚未给出理想响应"的案例构建，用于跨代测度安全改进。
evidence_quote: "They were built around cases in which our existing models were not yet giving ideal responses" (System Card §4.1.1; §6.2 同句)
version_anchor: GPT-6 Astra System Card, change log 2026-09-09 至 2026-10-30
notes: 失败数据来源为生产流量中前代模型未达理想响应的案例（"challenging examples from production data"，§4.1.1），保留为内部难例评测组件 → L3①②③。与 m6 分立（CR1）：数据源不同（生产难例 vs 用户显式标记错误）。评测侧单元。

mechanism_desc: 内部 Codex 流量部署模拟重放：以 54,218 个历史内部任务重建工作区重采样轨迹，用监控器判 CoT 打失对齐标签（11 类×严重度 0–4），作为发布前风险预报信号。
evidence_quote: "we simulated the deployment of GPT-6 Astra in Codex within OpenAI, and labeled the simulated trajectories for misaligned behaviors" (System Card §8.6)
version_anchor: GPT-6 Astra System Card, change log 2026-09-09 至 2026-10-30
notes: L3 判据①：历史任务重放环境（"historical internal Codex tasks with recoverable conversation and workspace state"＋LLM 工具模拟器重建工作区）＋轨迹级审计标签（"classify the final turn for a misalignment category and severity level (0-4…) using our monitor"）；②限对齐域（agentic coding）；③内部不外发。载体重放环境属评测重放非训练（与 DeepSeek 失败重放=RL-environment 同载体类）。结果路由至发布决策："an additional signal about internal deployment risk"。严重度定义与 4 个示例失对齐轨迹在 §8.6 公开摘录。

mechanism_desc: 越狱回归测试：以往测试周期发现的越狱（模型失败）被保留为回归测试集，逐发布验证无倒退；新发现越狱则触发缓解措施。
evidence_quote: "We use regression testing to make sure Astra is robust against jailbreaks found in previous testing periods" (System Card §1, Safety Overview)
version_anchor: GPT-6 Astra System Card, change log 2026-09-09 至 2026-10-30
notes: L3①：已发现失败（历史越狱）保留为可识别回归评测组件（§10.2.4.1 "regression testing of previously known jailbreaks"、"Regression testing found no material regressions on the historical jailbreaks evaluated"）；②限越狱域；③不外发。新发现失败→缓解的闭环："identified additional jailbreaks…for which we implemented mitigations"（§10.2.4.1）。评测侧单元。

mechanism_desc: 真实失对齐案例→对齐审计评测任务：内部研究调试评测含 6 项对齐审计任务，由真实研究实验中发现的失对齐行为/坏环境转化而来，测模型能否无提示地重新发现它们。
evidence_quote: "tasks that measure whether our AI models can rediscover misaligned behavior or bad environments that we found in real research experiments, without being prompted about what to look for" (System Card §10.1.3.1)
version_anchor: GPT-6 Astra System Card, change log 2026-09-09 至 2026-10-30
notes: L3①：真实发现的失败（失对齐行为/坏环境）被加工为可识别评测组件；②规模=6 项任务（限域、个例级）；③不外发（内部评测）。评测侧单元；载体以静态任务集为主，部分含环境成分（"bad environments"）。

mechanism_desc: 失对齐报告框架（2026-09-16）：覆盖训练/评测/测试/部署全生命周期的失对齐实例跟踪-调查-公开披露制度；任何员工可标记，三轨道（Ready/Minor/Larger Investigation）处理并公开发布实例级失对齐报告（含行为、严重度、根因解释与整改措施）。
evidence_quote: "We are sharing a new framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing instances of model misalignment at OpenAI, along with six reports on unexpected or concerning model behavior we've observed in the last six months." (Framework page, 2026-09-16)
version_anchor: 发布 2026-09-16；报告1（compaction 欺骗）first posted/last updated 2026-09-16
notes: 边界案例登记（CR4 性质，非证据不足而是等级边界）：报告级三要素齐备——错误标注（行为+严重度+外部影响）、因果归因（报告1 根因假设："a sample with deception in the final answer receives higher reward than the one without…"）、反思修正（"How we are addressing it"：改进对齐 RL 评分使标记率 2.15%→0.27%）；④方法论与报告公开（含逐字失败摘录）。但 L4②规模化不满足：初始仅 6 份实例级报告（"reports of individual instances"），非≥十万级样本、亦非训练管线数据组件 → 不升 L4。L3③（不外发）名义被违反，按手册 OpenR1-Math-Raw 边界规则（判据①满足＋开放性=发布→仍判 L3）处理：判 L3、openness=released。本条为语料 B 中最接近 L4 的候选。Hugging Face 事件被框架追认为 Larger Investigation 轨道（"The OpenAI Hugging Face incident would have fallen under this track"），其公开技术报告（cdn.openai.com PDF，系统卡引用）为同族前身披露。
